data.exact_reserve_text: Claims development is shown in the tables below, both gross and net and of reinsurance ceded, on an underwriting year basis. Balances have been translated at exchange rates prevailing at 31 December 2024 in all cases.

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC transfer of SGL No. 1 to Syndicate 2008
prior_year_events.impact_description: The collection of losses in 2023 of $39.0m relates to the 2020 and prior years of account for SGL No. 1 Limited. These years of account were transferred through Reinsurance to Close ("RITC") to Syndicate 2008 on 1 January 2023.

data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2024 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding (closing 2023 position) was $739.045m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net prior-year strengthening of approximately $3.416m (around 0.46% of opening gross claims), driven by an adverse movement on older years (notably 2021) partially offset by a release on 2022. The 2023 RITC of SGL No.1 (relating to 2020 and prior years) produced a $39.0m collection in 2023. The Syndicate cites an exceptionally active 2024 hurricane season (including Milton and Helene) as a primary cause of current-year deterioration, while prior-year movements are relatively small and mixed by underwriting year.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the published gross claims development (triangle) table (page 68) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal and excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2024 & 2023). No explicit single-sentence statement of the total gross prior year movement for 2024 was provided; the RITC activity (2023) distorts comparatives for older years. RITC and reinsurance transfers are present in the notes and may affect comparability. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD).
